"""Native duplicate-static settling regression; sources are copied per variant.

Run with PROGRAM_CACHE=0 so this executable tests the copied module directly.
The /usr/bin/true payload tests publication/lookup only; it is never executed.
"""
import os
import sys
import time
from src.pystachy_compiler import program_cache as pc

failures: list[int] = [0]


def check(value: bool, label: str) -> None:
    print("PASS" if value else "FAIL", label, flush=True)
    if not value:
        failures[0] += 1


def write(path: str, text: str) -> None:
    with open(path, "w", encoding="latin-1", newline="") as stream:
        stream.write(text)


def prepare(root: str, name: str) -> tuple[str, str, str, str]:
    directory = root + "/" + name
    os.mkdir(directory, 0o700)
    static = directory + "/compiler"
    source = directory + "/source.py"
    write(static, "first native compiler\n")
    write(source, "print(42)\n")
    pc.STATIC_MEMO.clear()
    pc.MEMO_ROOT[0] = ""
    pc.start()
    pc.track_source(source, "print(42)\n")
    pc.track_static(static)
    return (directory + "/cache", static, source, name)


def cross_threshold(snapshot: str) -> None:
    fields = pc._unpack(snapshot)
    check(len(fields) == 4 and fields[3] == "0", "first capture is unsettled")
    # Sleeping after the first capture makes this independent of compilation
    # speed. The following assertion proves the actual threshold was crossed.
    time.sleep(2.1)
    check(pc._settled(fields[1]), "same timestamps are now settled")


root = sys.argv[1]
os.mkdir(root, 0o700)
print("runtime", sys.implementation.name, "native_hash", pc.NATIVE, flush=True)
check(pc.NATIVE == (sys.implementation.name == "pystachy"), "native primitive selection")
payload = "/usr/bin/true"

cache, static, source, context = prepare(root, "unchanged")
first = pc.STATICS[static]
cross_threshold(first)
pc.track_static(static)
check(pc.VALID[0], "unchanged duplicate remains valid")
check(pc.STATICS[static] == first, "unchanged duplicate preserves original snapshot")
check(pc._unpack(pc.STATICS[static])[3] == "0", "unsettled validation policy is retained")
target = pc.publish(cache, context, payload)
check(target != "", "unchanged duplicate publishes")
hit = pc.lookup(cache, context)
check(target != "" and hit == target, "unchanged duplicate is a cache hit")

cache, static, source, context = prepare(root, "changed-static")
first = pc.STATICS[static]
write(static, "other native compiler\n")
cross_threshold(first)
pc.track_static(static)
check(not pc.VALID[0], "changed duplicate invalidates capture")
check(pc.STATICS[static] == first, "changed duplicate cannot replace original snapshot")
check(pc.publish(cache, context, payload) == "", "changed static cannot publish")
check(pc.lookup(cache, context) == "", "changed static cannot hit")

cache, static, source, context = prepare(root, "changed-source")
target = pc.publish(cache, context, payload)
check(target != "" and pc.lookup(cache, context) == target, "source control initially publishes and hits")
write(source, "print(43)\n")
check(pc.lookup(cache, context) == "", "changed source invalidates existing hit")
check(pc.publish(cache, context, payload) == "", "old source capture cannot republish")
pc.stop()
print("failures", failures[0], flush=True)
sys.exit(1 if failures[0] else 0)
